🌫️ Generative AI

Diffusion model

In simple words

An image generator that learns to remove noise step by step, turning random speckles into a picture that matches a prompt.

A kind of generative model behind many image generators. During training it sees pictures with more and more random noise added, and learns to undo the noise one small step at a time. To make a new image, it starts from pure noise and removes it step by step, guided by your text prompt.

Example. Imagine a photo slowly disappearing under TV-like static. A diffusion model learns to play that film backwards. Give it fresh static and the prompt “a cat in a spacesuit”, and a new picture appears out of the noise.

Related words

  • Generative AIAI that creates new text, images, music, video or code from patterns it has learned.
  • Generative adversarial network (GAN)Two neural networks trained against each other: one makes fakes, the other tries to catch them, and both get better.
  • AI watermarkA hidden or visible mark added to AI-made pictures, audio, video or text to show that AI created them.
